intro: The most developed IT industry in the Middle East and a large Russian-speaking diaspora. The repatriation programme (the Law of Return) is the simplest path to citizenship for Jews.
climate: Mediterranean on the coast, averaging +20°C; hot and semi-desert in Jerusalem and Beersheba. Mild, rainy winters and hot, dry summers.
mentality: A direct, informal communication style. A strong family culture, an active civic stance and open public debate.
language_note: Hebrew is the official language, used for all official documents. English is found in IT and high tech. Russian is spoken across a diaspora of over a million people.
visa_note: Entry via the B-1 (work) visa or Aliyah (repatriation). Tourists may stay up to 90 days without a visa. Long-term stay is only possible through work, study or citizenship.
